extracted.intended_audience: extramural grantee institution staff using eRA Commons to prepare and submit RPPRs (PD/PIs, PD/PI delegates, Signing Officials, Authorized Officials, Grants Management staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Step-by-step procedural guidance and rules for preparing, editing, routing, validating, and submitting Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPRs) in the eRA Commons RPPR module (includes agency-specific notes for NIH, AHRQ, VA, and Department of Commerce).

rubrics_metrics.name: RPPR module core features
rubrics_metrics.description: RPPR module features include electronic initiation of an RPPR; electronic routing of an RPPR to authorizing officials at the applicant organization for review and approval prior to submission to the agency; viewing of RPPR routing history; error checking capabilities; electronic submission of an RPPR; creation and electronic submission of Interim and Final RPPRs; ability for an SO to delegate authority to a PD/PI for submitting an RPPR (agency-specific exceptions apply); and a PDF generated version stored in the electronic grant folder (Commons Status Information screen).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these built-in capabilities to prepare, route, validate, and submit reports; note some items (e.g., delegations) are agency-specific (see DOC guidance).

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may initiate and who may submit an RPPR
rubrics_metrics.description: Only the program director/principal investigator (PD/PI) or their PD/PI delegate can initiate an RPPR and only a signing official (SO) can submit it. For MPI/Multi-PI awards, only the Contact PD/PI or the Contact PD/PI’s delegate can initiate the RPPR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For DOC awards, only the PD/PI (Contact PI for MPI) can initiate and no RPPR functionality can be delegated; only an SO can submit. Be sure the correct person initiates to ensure proper reviewer flow.

rubrics_metrics.name: RPPR availability windows and due date rules
rubrics_metrics.description: RPPR links appear for the current reporting period (timing differs by agency): for multi-year funded awards the RPPR link is available two months prior to the RPPR due date (NIH example); NIH SNAP vs non-SNAP due dates (SNAP: 15th of month preceding budget period end; non-SNAP: 1st of month preceding); AHRQ RPPRs are due three months before the anniversary; Fellowship reports due two months before next budget period. If the due date falls on a weekend or federal holiday, the due date is extended to next business day. A Notice of Award may supersede these dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check the Notice of Award and agency-specific guidance to determine the exact availability and due date for the RPPR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage RPPR access and search differences (PI vs SO/AO)
rubrics_metrics.description: After logging into eRA Commons select Status to access the RPPR module. PIs see their Not Started or in-progress RPPRs; Signing Officials and Authorized Officials see search options to find RPPRs from the organization and can limit by Awarding Office/IC.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the Manage RPPR screen to locate and open the RPPR Menu for a specific award; DOC awards may not appear on Manage RPPR (see DOC-specific access rules).

rubrics_metrics.name: RPPR status values and current reviewer logic
rubrics_metrics.description: Possible RPPR status values: Not Started, PD/PI Work in Progress, Reviewer Work in Progress, and Submitted to Agency. The PI who initiated the RPPR is automatically the current reviewer; when routed to someone else that person becomes the current reviewer and can edit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the current reviewer may edit the RPPR while in WIP status. The 'current reviewer' field is blank before initiation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Buttons/actions availability and role-based conditions (three-dot ellipsis menu)
rubrics_metrics.description: Actions available via the three-dot ellipsis vary by RPPR status and user role. Key actions: Initiate (available for Not Started grants to PD/PIs and delegates), Edit RPPR (available for WIP when the user is the current reviewer), View RPPR as PDF (available for WIP or Submitted to Agency to PD/PIs, PD/PI delegates, and reviewers; shows Draft until submitted), Check for Errors (WIP; any user with access), View Routing History (WIP or Submitted; appropriate roles), Route to Next Reviewer (WIP; available only to the current reviewer; PD/PI delegate cannot route), Recall (allows last reviewer to recall an RPPR from the current reviewer; Signing Officials and PD/PIs can recall when status is Reviewer Work in Progress in certain situations), Submit (WIP; available to SO when SO is current reviewer and to PD/PI when delegated Progress Report authority), Cancel (closes menu).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select actions appropriate to your role/status. Note some actions are explicitly disallowed for delegates (e.g., PD/PI delegate cannot route).

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiation and initiation validation behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Clicking Initiate creates the RPPR in PD/PI Work in Progress status and sets the initiator as current reviewer. If initiation fails due to business rules validations, error or warning messages display and initiation is blocked.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If prompted to correct Personal Profile or Institution Profile info after initiating, you may continue editing but the RPPR will not pass validations for submission until errors are corrected.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing workflow and Save requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Sections of the RPPR may be completed in any order while in WIP, but you must click the Save button before navigating away from a screen; navigating away without saving results in loss of any information entered since the last save.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Save frequently. The RPPR includes tabs and links for navigation; click Save before moving between sections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Changing saved responses warning and deletion behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: While in WIP status, changing a saved response triggers a warning: 'The entered/uploaded response will be deleted. Do you wish to continue?' Choosing Continue deletes the previous response, removes attachments, and disables associated fields; choosing Cancel cancels the change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be deliberate when replacing saved responses because associated attachments and fields may be removed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Text box character limits and indicators
rubrics_metrics.description: All text boxes on the RPPR have character limits. The number of characters available is reflected beneath each text box as characters are entered.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Monitor the character counter while composing entries to avoid truncation or loss of content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Table tools and bulk selection behaviors
rubrics_metrics.description: Tables include tools for filtering (instant filtering with highlights), sorting by column header, bulk select/deselect (select all vs select all visible), download/print (exports all columns even if hidden), and grid tool to specify rows per page. 'Check All' marks all checkboxes across all pages; 'Check All Visible' marks only those on the current page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use filter and sort to find records quickly; be aware of the distinction between Check All and Check All Visible when working across multiple pages.

rubrics_metrics.name: PDF upload/attachment requirements (flattened PDFs)
rubrics_metrics.description: PDF uploads for all RPPR sections are required to be a flattened PDF (no fillable forms or other layers such as movable images). If you attempt to upload a file that is not flattened, an error 'Error Uploading PDF. Please ensure all files are flattened. ....' is displayed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: To flatten in Adobe Acrobat Reader: choose Print -> 'Print to PDF' and save to a new file name. The file is not uploaded until the RPPR form is saved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Attachment limits for specific sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Section B.4 (training/professional development opportunities) permits one PDF no larger than 6MB. Section J. Misc. Documents (DOC only) allows uploading up to 20 documents of your choice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure uploaded files meet size and count limits and are flattened before saving the form.

rubrics_metrics.name: RPPR section structure and agency applicability (Sections A–J)
rubrics_metrics.description: The RPPR in Commons consists of separate screens for A. Cover Page; B. Accomplishments; C. Products; D. Participants; E. Impact; F. Changes; G. Special Reporting Requirements; H. Budget; I. Outcomes; and J. Misc. Documents (J only for DOC). Not all forms apply to all awards; see the NIH and Other PHS Agency RPPR Instruction Guide for completing Sections A–I (not applicable to DOC awards).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to the RPPR Instruction Guide for field-by-field guidance and to determine which sections apply to your award type. Note F and H may not apply for FRPPR and I is only for FRPPR, per the guide.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Products behavior and My NCBI integration
rubrics_metrics.description: For NIH, AHRQ, and VA awards, Form C automatically lists publications from My NCBI associated with the project; select checkboxes to affiliate publications with the RPPR. The DOC Products form does not connect to My NCBI — citations must be entered manually.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use bulk select tools for My NCBI lists; for DOC awards use the Add Citation dialog to enter manual citations. The Data Management and Sharing (DMS) section appears only for awards subject to the Final NIH DMS Policy.

rubrics_metrics.name: H. Budget and subaward budget handling
rubrics_metrics.description: You can add budget forms (SF-424 R&R, PHS 398 Training Budget, PHS Additional Indirect Costs) and subaward budget forms (SF-424 Research & Related Subaward Budget, PHS 398 Subaward Training Budget). Click Add to add and Edit (three-dot ellipsis) to modify. If subaward budgets are completed, the system will not calculate the budget line item F.5 for the main budget; total consortium costs for the main budget MUST be computed and entered manually into budget line item F.5. Budgets you added can be deleted via the three-dot ellipsis Delete option.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact your Grants Management Specialist for questions about which budget form to use. Save after editing budget forms.

rubrics_metrics.name: DOC-specific RPPR rules and exceptions
rubrics_metrics.description: DOC RPPRs are accessed ONLY via the Status module (they do not appear on the Manage RPPR screen). For DOC awards: RPPRs are due semi-annually; all DOC awards requiring RPPRs are multi-year; RPPRs should be completed/submitted in order (Semi-Annual RPPR 1 before 2, etc.); after submission you can modify and resubmit RPPRs until the agency accepts them (resubmitted RPPR replaces prior submitted RPPR); RPPR shows Section J. Misc. Documents (DOC-only); no delegation is allowed for DOC RPPR functionality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult your DOC grants management specialist for policy questions; use the Status module to initiate or access DOC RPPRs and follow the required sequence of semi-annual submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Validation/Check for Errors and business rules
rubrics_metrics.description: The Check for Errors action verifies the RPPR for errors or warnings and is available while the report status is Work in Progress (WIP). An RPPR may be prevented from initiation or submission due to business rules validations; error or warning messages will display.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Run validations early and often using Check for Errors; correct business-rule errors before attempting submission to avoid rejection.

rubrics_metrics.name: PDF generation on submission and Final RPPR access
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon submission to the awarding agency, the system generates a PDF of the progress report (View RPPR as PDF shows Draft until submission). Once submitted, the Final RPPR, in PDF format, is accessible in Commons via the Status Information screen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review the Draft PDF prior to submission; after submission access the Final PDF from Status Information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initiation order restrictions when multiple RPPR links exist
rubrics_metrics.description: If multiple RPPR Year or Semi-Annual RPPR links appear for an award, you are prevented from initiating a later progress report until the previous progress report(s) have been submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Complete and submit earlier reporting periods before initiating later ones to avoid blocked initiation.
